title: Distribution and sanity checks
description: Plot histograms for all numeric columns and a value-count bar chart for salary_band. Verify no unexpected gaps, spikes, or anomalies.
method: matplotlib histograms (bins=30) for numeric columns; bar chart for salary_band
validation: Visual inspection; confirm performance_rating is roughly normal/uniform with mean ~50 and std ~10

title: Pairwise correlation analysis
description: Compute Pearson and Spearman correlation matrices for all numeric columns. Generate heatmap. Report max |r| with performance_rating.
method: pandas .corr(method='pearson') and .corr(method='spearman'); seaborn heatmap; Bonferroni-corrected p-values via scipy.stats.pearsonr/spearmanr
validation: Flag any |r| > 0.10 with corrected p < 0.05. For pure noise expect all |r| < 0.10.

title: Non-linear relationship scan
description: Compute mutual information scores for each numeric predictor against performance_rating. Produce scatter plots with LOWESS for top-3 features.
method: sklearn.feature_selection.mutual_info_regression; statsmodels lowess smoother; compare MI scores against shuffled-target baseline (100 shuffles)
validation: If all MI scores fall within the 95% CI of shuffled baseline, accept H-NONLIN-NONE.

title: Salary band group comparison
description: Test whether mean performance_rating differs across salary_band levels using one-way ANOVA. Produce box plot.
method: scipy.stats.f_oneway; eta-squared = SS_between / SS_total; seaborn boxplot
validation: Report F-statistic, p-value, eta-squared. Accept H-SALARY-NODIFF if p >= 0.05 or eta-squared < 0.01.

title: Multicollinearity check
description: Compute VIF for all numeric predictors to assess collinearity.
validation: Flag any VIF > 5. For independently generated noise expect all VIF near 1.0.

title: Predictive model fit
description: Fit Random Forest regressor with 5-fold CV. Compare against dummy baseline. Compute permutation feature importances.
method: sklearn RandomForestRegressor(n_estimators=100, random_state=42); cross_val_score(cv=5, scoring='r2'); DummyRegressor(strategy='mean'); permutation_importance
validation: Accept H-MODEL-NOSIGNAL if mean CV R-squared <= 0.02. Report RMSE and compare to baseline RMSE.

title: Permutation noise confirmation test
description: Build null distribution of R-squared by shuffling performance_rating 200 times and refitting the model. Compare actual R-squared to this distribution.
method: For each of 200 iterations: shuffle performance_rating, fit RandomForestRegressor with 5-fold CV, record mean R-squared. Compute empirical p-value = (count of null R-squared >= actual R-squared) / 200.
validation: Accept H-NOISE if empirical p-value >= 0.05, confirming data is indistinguishable from pure noise.
